<title level="1" right="Hazard 7" pfs="">[Mist Projector](/Hazards.aspx?ID=406)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Cold" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=27" />
<trait label="Trap" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=158" />
<trait label="Water" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=165" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm](/Sources.aspx?ID=209) pg. 59

**Complexity** Simple

</column>

Hidden jets expel gas that quickly freezes, causing limited damage to nearby books.

---

**Stealth**
DC 23 (expert)

**Disable**
DC 27 [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) (expert) to deactivate the trap without its control key or DC 26 [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) to create and apply a chemical that neutralizes the gas.

<column gap="tiny">

**AC** 25, **Fort** +17, **Ref** +10

**Hardness**
15

**HP**
60 (BT 30)

**Immunities**
critical hits, object immunities, precision damage

</column>

**Icy Mist** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=27), [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=165)) **Trigger** The northeast bookshelf is touched; **Effect** Freezing mist fills a 30-foot cone originating from the room's northeast corner. Creatures in the area take 5d8 cold damage (DC 25 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude). Creatures who fail or critically fail the saving throw take 2d8 [persistent cold damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) for up to 3 rounds. The affected area is filled with mist that functions as [_obscuring mist_](/Spells.aspx?ID=210) for 3 rounds.

---
**Reset**
8 hours
